title: Contact
description: Canonical contact entity v1 (SIE-25). A customer or a supplier; the type decides which order direction it can be used with. The order schema (SIE-24) embeds a point-in-time snapshot of a contact's name/phone/address, not a live reference, so later edits here never retroactively change a historical order.

type.description: customer: used as the contact on a sale order. supplier: used as the contact on a purchase order.
